craftpilot.toast.title: CraftPilot
craftpilot.toast.body: CraftPilot API active on 127.0.0.1:%s. Type /craftpilot setup for AI setup.
craftpilot.setup.copied: CraftPilot: AI setup copied to clipboard. Paste it into claude_desktop_config.json (or see the mod page).
craftpilot.token.reset: CraftPilot: new API token generated and saved.
craftpilot.config.title: CraftPilot Settings
craftpilot.cmd.status.desc: Lets the AI read game state: screen, position, health, food, XP, dimension, FPS.
craftpilot.cmd.screenshot.desc: Lets the AI take screenshots of the game window.
craftpilot.cmd.screen.desc: Lets the AI read the buttons and fields on the current screen.
craftpilot.cmd.click_widget.desc: Lets the AI press buttons on the current screen by their name.
craftpilot.cmd.click.desc: Lets the AI click anywhere on the current screen.
craftpilot.cmd.scroll.desc: Lets the AI scroll lists on the current screen.
craftpilot.cmd.key.desc: Lets the AI press keyboard keys (like a real key press).
craftpilot.cmd.type.desc: Lets the AI type text into chat and text fields.
craftpilot.cmd.command.desc: Lets the AI run slash commands (/give, /tp, /time…). Disable for 'honest' survival.
craftpilot.cmd.chat.desc: Lets the AI send chat messages as you.
craftpilot.cmd.chat_log.desc: Lets the AI read recent chat messages.
craftpilot.cmd.move.desc: Lets the AI walk, jump, sneak and sprint.
craftpilot.cmd.look.desc: Lets the AI turn the camera.
craftpilot.cmd.hotbar.desc: Lets the AI change the selected hotbar slot.
craftpilot.cmd.use.desc: Lets the AI use items / right-click.
craftpilot.cmd.attack.desc: Lets the AI attack / break blocks (left-click).
craftpilot.cmd.inventory.desc: Lets the AI read your inventory.
craftpilot.cmd.world.desc: Lets the AI list, open, create and leave singleplayer worlds.
craftpilot.cmd.respawn.desc: Lets the AI respawn after death.
craftpilot.cmd.goto.desc: Lets the AI walk to coordinates by itself (simple pathfinding).
